note: McCreary County parcels are published only through the PVA's qPublic (Schneider) portal, listed as a subscription service; its viewer is blocked by a Cloudflare challenge and exposes no public ArcGIS REST parcel endpoint. No county-wide parcel service found on kygisserver.ky.gov (only Webster County PVA parcels there). The only ArcGIS parcel layer found (plumhilleco_18 Parcel_McCreary_NKUrequest) has just 12 features. Other McCreary parcel sources are commercial paid downloads.
